title: Enquirer’s Guide: Does a message mean someone lives in the Stratum?
author: The Enquirer’s Guide Desk
paragraphs: This entry from The Enquirer’s Guide answers a question often put to the Society: “Does a message mean someone lives in the Stratum?”

An answering pattern may be a response to an experiment, a delayed echo, a mistaken match, or something not yet understood. Eideticians can show that a signal depends on what they send; that alone does not prove that a person—or any other mind—sent it.

Readers should treat the answer as an introduction rather than a final authority. Eidetic science in Alderwick is reported through measurements, disputed interpretations and careful revisions, and a respectable enquiry may properly end with further questions.
